description: This file defines the ConsulGatewayListProvider class responsible for managing the gateway list in a Orleans cluster using Consul for service discovery and membership table retrieval. It implements the IGatewayListProvider interface, providing methods for initialization and fetching active gateway URIs.

classes.name: ConsulGatewayListProvider
classes.description: A class that provides gateway list management in an Orleans cluster utilizing Consul for membership data.

methods.name: ConsulGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with necessary dependencies such as loggers and options.

methods.name: MaxStaleness
methods.description: Property returning the maximum staleness duration for the gateway list.

methods.name: IsUpdatable
methods.description: Property indicating that the gateway list provider is updatable.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the Consul client for communication with the membership store.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active gateway URIs based on Consul membership data.
